text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Convex model with the same form as the synthetic truth, 100 synthetic substations (20 on each of 5 real substations). Dot: share of 80% intervals containing the truth. Line: 95% interval from resampling substations, then draws. Green band: 70 to 90%, the pre-registered pass range.'

from resampling substations, then draws. Green band: 70 to 90%, the pre-registered pass range.
